method.name: Equates
method.description: Specific testof equality : defined as False if <other> has not the same true Type, else contents are compared (by C++ operator ==)

method.name: ValueType
method.description: Returns the Type of the Value. By default, returns the DynamicType of <me>, but can be redefined

method.name: ValueTypeName
method.description: Returns the name of the Type of the Value. Default is name of ValueType, unless it is for a non-handled object
